title: FIFO with Assertions
description: Implement a FIFO with SystemVerilog assertions to check overflow and underflow conditions. Use SVA to ensure data integrity.
hint: Use FIFO pointers (write_ptr, read_ptr) and calculate full/empty conditions. Assertions should trigger when rules are violated.

title: ALU with Constrained Random
description: Create a constrained random testbench for an ALU. Use SystemVerilog classes and constraints to generate valid test cases.
hint: Create a class with rand variables and constraint blocks. Use randomize() to generate test cases. Add covergroups for coverage if needed.

title: Bus Interface Protocol
description: Implement a bus protocol using SystemVerilog interfaces. Create master and slave modules that communicate through the interface.
hint: Define interface with clocking blocks and modports. Use the interface to connect master and slave. Clocking blocks help with synchronization.

title: Router with Coverage
description: Implement a packet router with functional coverage. Use covergroups to track different packet types and routes.
hint: Use packages to organize types and covergroups. Sample coverage at appropriate points. Use different packet types to achieve high coverage.
